name: Alfords Point Bridge
facts: Alfords Point Bridge, a twin 445‑metre concrete and steel box girder structure, first opened on 7 September 1973, initially carrying a single lane in each direction despite being built for three lanes.
In 1980, a tidal‑flow system was installed, shifting two lanes northbound in the morning and two southbound in the evening, before the second bridge was added in 2008.

The 2008 southbound bridge left the original span for northbound traffic only, completing the duplication that had been planned with a second set of piles and abutments built during the original construction.
